problem: The adopted ETH long developed persistent canonical regime opposition while its native execution plan retained only the fixed 48-hour fallback and venue stop. The investigation tests whether a causal persistent-opposition adverse-close exit could reduce losses without post-outcome live intervention.
hypothesis: Five consecutive completed one-minute decisions with regime support at or below -0.5, combined with an adverse completed-close return threshold, may improve cost-adjusted exit quality relative to the native exit.
decision: Retain the live ETH exit contract unchanged and continue the frozen report-only comparison through lifecycle resolution.
limitations: The current ETH lifecycle is open and right-censored.
Only one closed exact ETH route lifecycle and one triggered current-profile lifecycle exist.
The mixed-profile aggregate combines seven incompatible profile generations.
The historical improvement is concentrated in one HYPE loss.
Coverage has 90 decision gaps and one evaluated decision without price evidence.

predeclared_experiment.comparison: actual native close for resolved lifecycles and frozen marked state for the still-open ETH lifecycle
predeclared_experiment.cost_model: measured lifecycle entry/exit fee and funding evidence as implemented by the challenger

research_tool_defect_and_correction.observed_contradiction: The checkpoint reported 60 opposed ETH decisions while the first challenger artifact reported zero and no trigger.
research_tool_defect_and_correction.root_cause: Lifecycle coverage filtered provider and canonical observations to the entry process run. The same-profile ETH position was adopted after a restart, so valid recovery-run evidence was excluded.
research_tool_defect_and_correction.correction: Coverage now uses the causal strategy-symbol and canonical timelines across process runs while retaining exact entry/end lifecycle bounds.
research_tool_defect_and_correction.tdd_falsifier: A lifecycle entered in one run with all five adverse opposed observations in a same-profile recovery run must report five observations and trigger at the fifth decision.

corrected_open_eth_result.interpretation: At the frozen cutoff, every triggered challenger had crystallized a larger loss than retaining the position to the later marked state. This open path contradicts an immediate claim that the early loss exit improved ETH economics. The lifecycle remains right-censored, so its final native outcome can update the comparison.

largest_delta_source.interpretation: One HYPE loss contributes more than 100% of the aggregate loss20 and loss30 improvement; removing it makes the improvement delta negative.

current_v51_profile_scope.interpretation: The exact-profile headline is based on three closes and one challenger trigger, so it is concentration evidence rather than a repeatable exit edge.

exact_eth_route_scope.interpretation: Both challengers reduce the one historical ETH loss but remain negative. One small prior-sizing lifecycle cannot qualify a live ETH exit policy.

decision_detail.recommendation: Do not change the live ETH exit contract from this evidence. Continue the frozen report-only comparison through lifecycle resolution.
decision_detail.confidence: High confidence that the corrected current ETH path does not support the early-exit change; low confidence about the policy's durable expectancy because compatible samples are sparse and concentrated.
decision_detail.minimum_evidence_to_update_diagnosis: Resolve ETH:516976976124 with exact exit fill, fees, funding, slippage, and reason, then compare its final native net with every frozen challenger. Add at least three independent exact-v51 ETH triggers with both sides represented for another diagnostic update.
decision_detail.minimum_evidence_for_change_proposal: A predeclared prospective exact-v51 window with at least ten fully covered ETH triggers across both sides, positive cost-inclusive delta after removing the largest improvement, no single lifecycle contributing more than half the delta, and an untouched forward confirmation window. This is a minimum review threshold, not statistical proof.
decision_detail.failure_or_rejection_trigger: Reject the challenger if the resolved current ETH lifecycle plus the predeclared prospective window remains worse than native after costs, or if the apparent edge disappears after concentration and profile-compatibility controls.
decision_detail.reopen_condition: New exact-v51 ETH evidence may reopen parameter or side-specific evaluation only if it is prospective, independently resolved, and materially changes the concentration-adjusted result.

evidence.role: invalidated pre-fix artifact retained for traceability

falsifier: This decision must be updated if the exact ETH lifecycle resolves below the frozen challenger after complete cost normalization, or if a predeclared compatible forward window shows broad, side-balanced, concentration-robust improvement over native exits.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Collect and resolve the exact v51 SPCX long and short lifecycle evidence because it is the largest current strategy-economics identity gap; SP500 is second. The ETH challenger remains frozen until the current lifecycle closes rather than consuming another retrospective tuning cycle.
